scheme_name: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Widow Pension Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands or have resided there for more than 10 years
Applicant must be a poor widow
Applicant must not be availing any other financial assistance or grant from the government or any other source
Assistance will cease if the beneficiary remarries or becomes financially independent
benefits_summary: Widow allowance of ₹2500 per month paid into the beneficiary's bank account.
